about: THE LENDER'S STICK (8 Oct 2026, night; Design/DECISIONS.md 104 and 105). The debt for the boat in a game begun through the opening (flag lender_opening), owed to Wursing, called the Wōkerer: his man who keeps turning up to ask for something on the stick (DECISIONS 33: the user's own idea; any sum may be paid, wherever he finds her), the day itself and the days after it (unpaid, she works for the lender: half of what she sells goes to the stick until it is clean), and the stick made clean. The count's old chain (chain_house_debt_793.json) sleeps in such a game. Flags: wk_met (he has been met), wk_wait_far / wk_wait_mid / wk_wait_near (lapsing: he does not come while the one for the season stands), wk_hid_grace (falls by four each time she hides: the odds of it being funny fall with it), wk_work (she works for him), wk_clean (the stick is given up). Words: Data/writing/wokerer.json. EVERY WORD IS A PLACEHOLDER for the user's own, and the man's name (Bubo) is the user's to give.

cards.note: The lender's man at the home berth (DECISIONS 33 and 104). He comes when she moors, no sooner than his last word allows (the three wk_wait flags: seldom while Michaelmas is far, often when it is near, sooner after he was put off), from ten days into the game. Any sum may be paid and he cuts the notch there (law debt_pay_N). Hiding wears thin: its odds fall each time (flag wk_hid_grace). He is never pressing and never angry.

cards.note: MICHAELMAS, and every day after it while the stick is not clean and she does not yet work for him (DECISIONS 104, decided by me, the user's to overrule). The lender asks for all of it. Paid: the stick is clean (then: the clean stick). Not paid: he may ask back no more than the sum (the law of 789), so he takes the boat's work: from now half of what she sells goes to the stick before it reaches the purse (flag wk_work, Trade.WorkShare), until it is clean. Nothing is added to the debt, and the game does not end.
